zh: 使充满，灌输，激发（强烈感情、想法或价值）
en: to fill somebody/something with strong feelings, opinions or values
ex: Her voice was imbued with an unusual seriousness.
她的声音里充满着一种不寻常的严肃语气。

zh: 国际货币基金组织（联合国专门机构，关注贸易和经济的发展）
en: International Monetary Fund (the organization within the United Nations that is concerned with trade and economic development)

zh: in my humble opinion (used especially in emails, in text messages, on social media, etc. when you give your opinion about something)
en: in my humble opinion (used especially in emails, in text messages, on social media, etc. when you give your opinion about something)
ex: IMHO this film is a classic.
恕我直言，这部电影是经典。

zh: 模仿（某人的讲话、举止）；作滑稽模仿
en: to copy somebody/something
ex: Her style of painting has been imitated by other artists.
她的绘画风格为其他画家所模仿。

zh: 模仿（某人）的言谈举止；（尤指）滑稽模仿
en: a copy of something, especially something expensive
ex: a poor/cheap imitation of the real thing
低劣的仿制品

en: that copies somebody/something
ex: movies that encourage imitative crime
助长模拟犯罪行为的电影

zh: 模仿者；模拟…的人（或事物）
en: a person or thing that copies somebody/something else
ex: The band's success has inspired hundreds of would-be imitators.
乐队的成功激励了数以百计未来的追随者。

en: perfectly clean and tidy, with no marks or flaws
ex: She always looks immaculate.
她总是打扮得干净利落。

en: in an extremely clean and tidy way
ex: immaculately dressed
衣着整洁

zh: 内在的；固有的；无所不在的
en: present as a natural part of something; present everywhere
ex: God is immanent in the world.
上帝无所不在。

en: not important in a particular situation
ex: The cost is immaterial.
费用并不重要。

zh: （行为）不成熟的，不够老练的，幼稚的
en: behaving in a way that is not sensible and is typical of people who are much younger
ex: immature behaviour
不成熟的行为

zh: （行为）不成熟的，不够老练的，幼稚的
en: behaviour that is not sensible and is typical of people who are much younger
ex: emotional immaturity
情绪不成熟

zh: 不可估量的；无限的；无穷的
en: too large, great, etc. to be measured
ex: to cause immeasurable harm
造成不可估量的损害
